text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is an original research article, not a review. It uses refined regional land-use change (LUC) scenarios for Brazil developed by Bezerra et al. (2022) as input to drive a land surface model (INLAND) under two future climate and socioeconomic scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP3-RCP8.5). However, the primary objective of the study is to evaluate the impacts of climate and land-use change on carbon and water fluxes and stocks across Brazilian biomes—not to develop or predict LULC changes themselves. The LULC projections are adopted from prior work and used as forcing data; the paper does not present new LULC modeling, accuracy metrics, or mapped LULC projections as outputs. While the study operates at the national scale and uses multiple scenarios, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction. Instead, LULC change is an input component, making this a 'POSSIBLE' case.)
